models.name: AI models
models.loaded: {{.App}} has this model loaded right now. Unload it or quit {{.App}} first.
models.app_running: {{.App}} is running and may be using this model. Quit {{.App}} first.
models.llmstore: Managed by llmstore. LM Studio, Ollama and your apps use APFS clones of this file, so deleting it here frees almost nothing. Remove it with llmstore.
models.lmstudio.title: LM Studio
models.lmstudio.what: Models downloaded in LM Studio's Discover tab.
models.lmstudio.why: Every model can be downloaded again from LM Studio. Nothing else depends on these files.
models.lmstudio.after: The model disappears from LM Studio's list; downloading it again takes time and bandwidth (often several GB).
models.ollama.title: Ollama
models.ollama.what: Models pulled with ollama pull or ollama run. Size shown is what deleting frees: layers shared with other models stay.
models.ollama.why: Any model can be pulled again with ollama pull. Models loaded right now can't be selected.
models.ollama.after: ollama run will download the model again the next time you use it.
models.huggingface.title: Hugging Face cache
models.huggingface.what: Models and datasets that Python libraries (transformers, sentence-transformers, diffusers) downloaded from Hugging Face.
models.huggingface.why: Libraries download them again automatically the next time code asks for them.
models.huggingface.after: The next run of a script that uses the model downloads it first, and won't work offline until then.
models.apps.title: Models downloaded by apps
models.apps.what: Models that apps keep in their own folders: for example language and voice models of Lingary or Argos Translate languages.
models.apps.why: These apps download a model again when they need it. Models of a running app can't be selected.
models.apps.after: The app asks to download the model again or downloads it on first use. Features that need it don't work offline until then.
models.llmstore.title: llmstore
models.llmstore.what: The shared model store of llmstore in ~/Library/Models: one copy of the weights, cloned into LM Studio, Ollama and apps.
models.llmstore.why: Shown for information only: deleting a store file doesn't free space while its clones exist.
models.llmstore.after: Use llmstore to remove a model everywhere at once.
